versions.subject: Create proc_creation_win_lolbin_sideload_link_binary.yml
versions.detection:
selection:
    Image|endswith: '\link.exe'
    CommandLine|contains:
        - 'LINK /' # Hardcoded command line when we call tools like dumpbin.exe, editbin.exe, lib.exe...etc
# Add other filters for other legitimate locations
filter_visual_studio:
    ParentImage|startswith:
        - 'C:\Program Files\Microsoft Visual Studio\'
        - 'C:\Program Files (x86)\Microsoft Visual Studio\'
    ParentImage|contains: '\VC\Tools\MSVC\'
condition: selection and not 1 of filter_*
versions.spl: Image="*\\link.exe" CommandLine="*LINK /*" NOT (ParentImage IN ("C:\\Program Files\\Microsoft Visual Studio\\*", "C:\\Program Files (x86)\\Microsoft Visual Studio\\*") ParentImage="*\\VC\\Tools\\MSVC\\*")
